project.name: Four-site Hamiltonian spectra and RS-volume observables
project.subtitle: Exact diagonalization of the hopping-plus-on-site-repulsion operator H_G=-t Σ_(i,j)∈E_G(E_ij+E_ji)+(U/2)Σ_i n_i(n_i−1), where E_ij=a_i†a_j+b_i†b_j and n_i=a_i†a_i+b_i†b_i. Four sites, fixed boson number 2K and total spin zero; K=2,3,4 gives dimensions 20,50,105, with empty sites allowed. Compare the complete graph (6 hopping bonds) and periodic ring (4), with equal t per bond. The 30 cases use (t,U)=(0,1) or t=1 and U/t=0,1,5,20.
